remarks.zh: 计算橱柜的板材尺寸。 [宽度], [高度],[深度] 是总尺寸，[板材厚度] 是顶部、底部和侧板的厚度，[背板厚度] 是背景板的厚度。 (AI translated, please check)
remarks.en: Calculates board sizes for a cabinet. [Width], [Height],[Depth] is total Measurement, [BoardThick] is Top, Bottom and Side Board material thickness, [BackBoardThick] is Background Board material thickness.
remarks.ms: Mengira saiz papan untuk kabinet. [Width], [Height],[Depth] adalah ukuran keseluruhan, [BoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan atas, bawah dan sisi, [BackBoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan belakang. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.id: Menghitung ukuran papan untuk kabinet. [Width], [Height],[Depth] adalah total ukuran, [BoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan atas, bawah, dan samping, [BackBoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan belakang. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.th: คำนวณขนาดกระดานสำหรับตู้ [ความกว้าง], [ความสูง],[ความลึก] คือขนาดรวม, [ความหนากระดาน] คือความหนาของวัสดุด้านบน ด้านล่าง และด้านข้าง, [ความหนากระดานหลัง] คือความหนาของวัสดุกระดานหลัง (AI translated, please check)
remarks.vi: Tính kích thước bảng cho một tủ. [Width], [Height],[Depth] là kích thước tổng thể, [BoardThick] là độ dày vật liệu của bảng trên, bảng dưới và bảng bên, [BackBoardThick] là độ dày vật liệu của bảng nền. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.tl: Kinakalkula ang mga laki ng tabla para sa isang kabinet. [Width], [Height],[Depth] ay kabuuang Sukat, [BoardThick] ay kapal ng materyal para sa Pang-itaas, Panimulang bahagi at Gilid na tabla, [BackBoardThick] ay kapal ng materyal ng Lagtang tabla. (AI translated, please check)
